review.json.scope: Independent source review, no library body or Document edits; small correctness/fault fixtures, no heavy DRAM timing.

findings.trigger: Small-mode solve successfully allocates the level vector with zero-filled new elements, then cursor/queue/stack preparation throws. Auxiliary additions cross V=65536 before retry.
findings.effect: Sparse BFS resets only prior queue plus sink, so nonqueued zero levels are mistaken for visited vertices and a feasible source-to-sink path is skipped. Reproducer returned -2 versus independently evaluated optimum1.
findings.fix: Parent initializes newly grown level elements to -1 in the small-mode solve preparation as well. Both modes now preserve the queue/level invariant if a later preparation allocation fails.
findings.fixture_conditions: 54 cases: int8/int64; first solve at V65534/65535; successful earlier solve then one auxiliary vertex before failure; allocation budgets0..4 cover all four preparation reservations; direct crossing plus copy/move/clear/small-mode retry recovery; an additional auxiliary term after entering large mode.
findings.fixture_reference: Exhaustive16 assignments of four active variables; all other variables carry no energy. Checks solve/repeated solve/reconstruct/solve_with_assignment and allocation live delta.

proofs: For each nonroot parent p>=1, children are4p-1 through4p+2; child j>=1 has parent(j+1)/4. The root has children1 and2; the formulas agree at the boundary.

p<=count/4 is exactly the existence condition4p-1<count, so the first child is valid; subsequent probes stop at min(count,first+4). vector<int> storage bounds keep first+4 and push(position+1) representable.
Descending repair from count/4 to1 establishes every nonroot subtree before root repair. Empty/singleton construction returns early, and repair_root is called only for nonempty heaps.

push_back is the only throwing step in push; int relocation and subsequent comparison/repair cannot throw. Failed reserve/copy/range construction use vector ownership and leave live objects intact or destroy partial construction.
The final GCC default mixed tree and standard binary fallback keep the same logical min-heap results for pop, replace_top and push_pop, including ties and extreme integers.
allocation_cases: copy constructor/assignment failure preserves source and target
single-pass range construction with several partial-allocation failures leaks nothing
independent sorted-array checks for every minimum position at sizes1..24 and replacement below/equal/above minimum
heap_review.notes: A noinline copy factory prevents the optimizer from eliding the deliberate unused-copy allocation test. No implementation change resulted.

project_invariants: After either BFS, every nonnegative level belongs to an entry in queue_ or to sink_. Sparse reset of precisely those vertices is sound; initialization of new level elements to-1 is required when preparations can throw.
Every vertex read by bounded/iterative flow was queued by the current BFS, except sink, which returns before reading cursor. Selective cursor reset therefore covers every accessed cursor.

Normal and sparse paths share queue semantics, so switching paths at V65536 is safe once the new-level initialization invariant is maintained. clear/init reset both levels and queue; copy/move/swap transfer all associated state together.
Adding auxiliary vertices only appends stable vertex indices. New cursor elements start0 and new level elements start-1; reserve-only preparation failures do not alter graph edges or the optimum.
Capacity remains below the unsigned hard sentinel; remaining=finite-flow+1 is representable, and level/edge/reverse indices stay within the existing checked int bounds.
configurations: GCC/Clang × checked/skip × O2 default/O2 native/ASanUBSan for each added small fixture
review.json.sanitizer_note: LeakSanitizer disabled under the host ptrace environment; independent live-allocation counters verify live_delta=0. ASan and UBSan remain enabled.
known_inconclusive_artifacts: cross-checks.json used an initial snapshot that raced with the parent fix and accidentally captured finalSHA2460d832; it is not old-version evidence. The correctly frozen pre-fix snapshot is project_before_exception_fix.hpp, and the independent author reproduction8 matrix is referenced above.
